description.value:
You are protected from physical harm. You gain resistance 5 to non-magical physical damage (except silver). Once per day, at any distance, the devil who holds this bargained contract can invoke a punitive damages clause as a single action with the concentrate trait to deal fire damage to you equal to twice your level, ignoring resistances, and gain half that many Hit Points.

Activate—Reasonable Force 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cite a right of self-defense article in your contract. The contract casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Diabolical Mantle], and you can then [[/act shove]] or [[/act demoralize]] an adjacent creature.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
